senses.gloss: † गोम् गोम्, i. 10, गोमय (rather for गोमयय, and a denomin. derived from गोमय), Par. To smear with cowdung.

गोमन्त् गो + मन्त्,
 I. adj., f. मती,
 1. Possessing cows, Chr. 295, 14 = Rigv. i. 92, 14; Chr. 287, 2 = Rigv. i. 48, 2 (गोमतीस्, ved. for गोमत्यस्).
 2. Abounding in cows, Chr. 292, 3 = Rigv. i. 86, 3.
 II. f. मती,
 1. The name of a river, the modern Goomti, [] MBh. 3, 8051.
 2. The name of a vedic hymn, MBh. 13, 3844.
गोमय गो + मय, m. and n. Cowdung, Man. 3, 206.
गोमयाय गोमयाय, a denomin. derived from गोमय, by the aff. य, Ātm. To taste like cowdung, Hit. iii. d. 56.
गोमायु गोमायु, i. e. गो- 2. मा + उ, m. A jackal, Man. 4, 115.
गोमिन् गो + मिन्, m. The owner of cattle, Yājñ. 2, 161.
गो- + मातृ गो- + मातृ, adj. having a cow as mother, Chr. 291, 3 = Rigv. i. 85, 3.
गो- + मिथुन गो- + मिथुन, n. a bull and a cow, Man. 3, 29.
गो- + मुख गो- + मुख, m. 1. a proper name, MBh. 5, 3574. 2. a certain musical instrument, Bhāg. P. 1, 10, 15.
